question: What is Brazil's co2 per capita in 2022? (A) 2.1 t (B) 2.3 t (C) 1.9 t. Answer with just the letter.
description: MT attack on the climate line chart. All series are drawn in near-identical blues, so series are hard to tell apart. Misleader from Lo et al., 'Misinformed by Visualization' (EuroVis 2022): ineffective color scheme. True answer: B (2.3 t). Bait: C (1.9 t).
